gizmo.title: Ihe nkiri ọnọdụ
gizmo.description: Otu ihe nkiri nke ọnọdụ nwere alaka. Jikọọ nhọrọ ọ bụla na ihe nkiri ọzọ site na # sochiri id ihe nkiri ya.

configure.title: Id ihe nkiri
configure.description: Ihe nhọrọ na-ejikọ na ya: njikọ na # sochiri id a na-eduga n'ihe nkiri a. Mkpụrụedemede, ọnụọgụ na hyphen.

configure.title: Njedebe
configure.description: Ma ihe nkiri a ọ na-akwụsị ụzọ, na otu o si gaa.

configure.title: Akara
configure.description: Akara maka iru njedebe a. Akara njedebe kacha elu n'ọnọdụ ahụ bụ oke kacha elu.
